name: Times Tables
description: Pick the tables you want and practise them at your pace or race against 60 seconds. Stars for every table you master.
prompt: A times tables trainer for kids: pick which tables to practise, a big number keypad, a relaxed practice mode of 20 questions and a 60-second race with a high score. Mistakes come back later, and each table earns up to three stars.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Elige las tablas que quieras y practícalas a tu ritmo o contra 60 segundos. Estrellas por cada tabla que domines.
